en: This is a black-and-white postcard composed of four main photographic panels. The largest panel in the top left shows a grand arched railway viaduct crossing a valley with a river and a smaller arched stone bridge in the foreground, surrounded by houses and trees. The top right panel shows an industrial railway facility with tracks and a large wooden building with a tall smokestack. The bottom left panel depicts a railway station with people standing on the platform, featuring late 19th or early 20th-century architecture. The bottom right panel shows a freight train on tracks. There is some floral artwork and partial printed text visible in the lower right corner.
